why: Phase C opener rule (#2304, prod 2026-10-13 Unhedged 'Is the Fed the referee...'): on a two-host show the second host OPENS the episode with a promo naming the show, then the first host introduces herself. The opener may take the second seat because it presents -- it names the show. Restricting the opener to 'no host seated yet' left this host unnamed.
